# stripe_radar_value_list_item (Data Source)

A value in a Radar value list. `terraform destroy` deletes the item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_radar_value_list_item" "spammer" {
  id = stripe_radar_value_list_item.spammer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `created_by` (String) The name or email address of the user who added this item to the value list.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `value` (String) The value of the item (whose type must match the type of the parent value list).
- `value_list` (String) The identifier of the value list which the created item will be added to.
